body: Pedestrian Safety Advisory Committee - Special Meeting
agenda_text:
PEDESTRIAN SAFETY ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 21, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  COLORADO CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 4:00 PM

Wendy Ili, Vice Chair  Kaferman Guan, Member
Jill Birdwell, Member  Rhea Lewitzki, Member
Brandi Brown-Shock, Member  Michelle Mowery, Member
Roberto Castillo, Member  Danielle Potter, Member

Paul Van Dyk, City Traffic Engineer, Chair  Shannon Hilleshiem, PTA Representative
Diane Golden, Nonpublic Schools Representative  Kezia Bailey, LBUSD Representative

  SPECIAL MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54110  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Pedestrian Safety Advisory
  Committee meeting of Wednesday, July 9, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54111  Recommendation to review and approve the updated hazardous locations table.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54112  Recommendation to make findings in accordance with Chapter 10.68 of the Long
  Beach Municipal Code and recommend to the City Council the installation of a
  school crossing guard at the intersection of Burnett Street and Pacific Avenue.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54105  Recommendation to make findings in accordance with Chapter 10.68 of the Long
  Beach Municipal Code and recommend to the City Council the removal of school
  crossing guards at the intersections of Pacific Coast Highway and Walnut
  Avenue and 10th Street and Orizaba Avenue.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54113  Recommendation to receive and file a summary of the updated supplemental
  prioritization analysis identifying prioritization factors for school crossing guard
  placement at non-hazardous locations.

  Page 1 of 2
   PEDESTRIAN SAFETY ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 21, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  COLORADO CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 4:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Pedestrian Safety Advisory Committee on non-agenda items. Each
speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Jonathan Nagayama, City Clerk Analyst, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101
or cityclerk@longbeach.gov.

If oral language interpretation for non-English speaking persons is desired or if a special
accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, please make your request
by phone to the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101, 24 business hours prior to the Charter
Commission meeting.

If written language translation of the Commission agenda and minutes for non-English speaking
persons is desired, please make your request by phone to the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-
6101, 72 business hours prior to the Commission meeting.
